name: Information Party Role
definition: Role played by a party as source of information.

GenericIdentification.name: Generic Identification
GenericIdentification.definition: Specifies the identification for which a party plays the issuer role.

HaircutValuation.name: Haircut Valuation
HaircutValuation.definition: Specifies the haircut valuation for which a party provides the information.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Specifies the security price for which a party plays a role.

Scheme.name: Scheme
Scheme.definition: Scheme for which the party is the source.

Quote.name: Quote
Quote.definition: Quoting process in which an information party plays a role.

TreasuryTrade.name: Treasury Trade
TreasuryTrade.definition: Trade for which a quote is provided.
